p9_b0.ocr: The first table presents the reference, structure of fiber, coating material, sensitivity, sensing range, and response time for various optical fibers. The entry for "This paper" lists a twisted macro-bend coupling structure with agarose coating, a sensitivity of 4.23 nW/%, a sensing range of 40–90%, and a response time of 1 second. The reference [13] features a singlemode polymer fiber Bragg, with no coating, a sensitivity of 0.23 mV/%, a sensing range of 10–90%, and a response time of 4.5 seconds.

p9_b1.ocr: Reference [14] details a side polished fiber with WS2 film, a sensitivity of 0.1213 dB/%, a sensing range of 35– 85%, and a response time of 1 second. The side polished fiber in reference [15] utilizes reduced graphene oxide, exhibiting a sensitivity of 0.31 dB/%, a sensing range of 70–95%, and a response time of 5 seconds. Reference [16] describes a tapered POF with HEC/PVDF, showing a sensitivity of 0.023 mV/%, a sensing range of 50–85%, and no response time reported.
